Public beta

This notice describes the present site. Hosting retention and international-transfer arrangements still need confirmation before public launch. Ads and analytics are not enabled.

01About this policy

This policy covers apina’s current browser-game website at apina.app. The application offers nine playable browser games, including Offensive Card PvP bot and friend duels. It also offers search, category filters, locally saved favorites and optional local best scores. It does not currently offer player accounts, payments, advertising, embedded third-party games or audience analytics.

Website operator & data controllerOtto-Emil HeiskanenFinlandapina.app.mankind189@passinbox.com

02Information and purposes

  • Saved favorites: game identifiers are stored in your browser when you use the heart button. The application reads them to show your collection. This list is not sent to an apina application server or linked to a player account.
  • Game scores: scores are kept in memory for the current visit by default. If you choose “Remember scores on this device”, best scores and that choice are stored in your browser. These local best scores are not uploaded to an apina application server. Online Offensive Card PvP moves are processed separately as described below.
  • Search and filters: these work in the page. The application does not send your search text or category choices to an analytics service.
  • Website delivery: hosting and security infrastructure may process your IP address, requested URL, request time, browser information and error or security events to deliver and protect the site.
  • Contact messages: if you email the operator, your address, message and any details you choose to provide are processed to answer you and handle your request. Please do not send unnecessary sensitive information.

Online Offensive Card PvP: when you create or join a room, the configured multiplayer server receives your chosen display name and game moves. It stores the room, private hands, decks, short match log and reconnect tokens to run the duel and restore your connection. Your opponent sees your display name, public health and energy, played cards and hand count, but not your hand or reconnect token. A room code or invite link lets one friend join. Bot matches run locally and do not use the multiplayer server.

Reconnect storage: online matches use a session-storage entry in your browser containing the server address, room code and your reconnect token. It is cleared when you leave or finish the match, or when the browser ends the tab session.

No profiling or automated decisions with legal or similarly significant effects are implemented by this application.

03Legal bases

Where personal data is involved, operational security and handling ordinary correspondence rely on legitimate interests: providing a reliable website, preventing abuse and responding to visitors. These interests must be balanced against visitors’ rights. Data needed to meet a specific legal obligation is processed on that basis.

The favorites feature stores the game IDs needed to provide the saving function you explicitly request. Persistent score storage is optional and disabled by default; you can enable it on a game page and withdraw that choice at any time. It is not used to track you across websites. Optional advertising or analytics would require a separate assessment and, where applicable, prior consent; neither is enabled in this version.

04Providers and sharing

The public website is hosted on Cloudflare Pages. The included Offensive Card PvP multiplayer backend runs on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects when deployed; if you choose a different server in the lobby, that server handles your online match data. Cloudflare handles delivery and infrastructure security and may process technical request information for these purposes. No apina player account or sign-in is required to play.

Contact email passes through the operator’s mailbox or forwarding service and the sender’s email provider. Data may also be disclosed when legally required or necessary to address a security incident. The current application has no mechanism to sell favorites or share them with advertisers.

Provider information: Cloudflare privacy policy.

05Retention and international processing

Favorites, opted-in scores and the score-storage choice remain in this browser until you remove them, clear this site’s storage, or your browser deletes them. They have no automatic expiry. Private browsing or restricted storage may keep them only for the current visit.

The included multiplayer backend deletes waiting rooms after 30 minutes, completed rooms after 10 minutes, and all rooms no later than 24 hours after creation. These limits apply to application room storage; hosting-provider logs follow the provider’s retention settings. Other multiplayer servers may use different retention settings.

Correspondence is kept only as needed to resolve the request, meet applicable legal obligations or address a dispute. Provider logs and email copies are subject to the selected services’ retention arrangements.

Hosting and email providers may process information outside the EEA. The applicable locations, retention settings and transfer safeguards must be verified against the provider arrangements before public launch. This policy does not claim that all information remains in Finland or the EEA.

06Your choices and rights

You can remove individual favorites with the heart button or clear them all on the GDPR & cookies page. That page also lets you erase stored scores and withdraw score storage. This only affects this browser and site address.

Where the GDPR applies, you may request access, correction, erasure or restriction, object to legitimate-interest processing, and request portability where its conditions are met. You may withdraw consent for any processing based on consent. These rights have legal conditions and exceptions.

Send a request to apina.app.mankind189@passinbox.com. You can also complain to a competent supervisory authority, including Finland’s Office of the Data Protection Ombudsman. More information and request handling details appear on the GDPR page.

07Changes to the service

This notice will be revised when the site’s data practices change. New accounts, third-party games, ads or analytics must be assessed and disclosed before they are introduced. Material changes will be highlighted on the site. The update date appears at the top of this page.
